title: Water tracker with fasting/Ramadan integration
goal: Daily-touch habit feature every competitor has; critical between iftar and suhoor
steps: Add water card on Home: quick-add buttons (كوباية 250ml / زجاجة 500ml / custom), daily goal (default 2L, adjustable)
Progress visual consistent with the mascot-wave style language
Ramadan/fasting mode: goal window = iftar to suhoor, reminder copy: 'شربت كام كوباية من الإفطار للسحور؟'
Store locally, offline-first, sync into daily log
acceptance: Logging a glass takes 1 tap from Home
Ramadan mode shifts the tracking window correctly
